title: Before-push review of tests and rules
summary: An independent AI tries edge cases and reports findings. The coding AI may respond with a test or a new rule. The check asks whether the authorized action still completes.
route: Packaged UserPromptSubmit hook in an external project

changes.title: Review tests and software rules before pushing
changes.problem: The previous hook told the coding agent to capture before-and-after evidence. It had no instruction to examine the outgoing tests and software rules before a push.
changes.decision: Check the changes made in response to independent review findings, including rules added without a new test. Verify the actual result for the reported and ordinary valid cases.
changes.impact: The same external project receives the existing screenshot instruction and the new before-push check. This hook provides instructions to the coding agent.
